messages:
Maya: ACME escalated: need per-tenant routing parity OR a supported fallback by end of Q2. They asked for dates.
Liam: Parity is 10-12w; a shim MVP could be 4-6w if we limit UI.
Arjun: Tech note: current schema is org-scoped. Shim path needs mapping layer + safety checks. Risk: extra latency.
Priya: Product suggestion: offer "compatibility shim v1" to unblock procurement. Document limitations clearly.
Kevin (sales): ACME will accept a temporary shim if we provide a clear GA timeline and rollback plan. Need customer-facing ETA today.
Liam: Launch criteria proposal for shim-MVP:
- Shim enabled with documented limitations
- Minimal Console (list/create) only
- Feature flag + rollback path
- Canary rollout + E2E smoke tests
Priya: Add SLO: routing latency increase <=20% and must pass ACME sample traffic.
Arjun: Rollout plan: 5% orgs -> 25% -> 100% with fast rollback. Track tech-debt ticket for full parity.
Maya: Action items: Liam scope console PR by EOD; Arjun migration/rollout plan in 48h; Priya write external limitations doc tomorrow; Kevin relay ETA to ACME.
Kevin (sales): I'll tell ACME compatibility-shim ETA and ask for +2w buffer.
Maya: OK I'll update roadmap and mark full parity as follow-up epic.
Liam: No objections from eng.
Arjun: Agreed, but we must schedule the parity epic in the backlog.
Priya: We'll name external offering "compatibility-mode v1".
Maya: Thanks team — I'll post a short brief to #exec-sync after rollout plan is ready.
